tha-ap74:1.1: Padasaññaka.] Akkantañ ca padaṃ disvā Tissassādiccabandhuno / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena pade cittaṃ pasādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap74:2.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi padasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap74:3.1: Ito sattamake kappe Sumedho nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahābalo. // //
tha-ap74:4.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ
tha-ap74:5.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
